Name: Working in Stardew Valley
Author: K1riko87
Description:
[size=4]Joja 又来信了。你的旧工位还空着。
接受返岗邀请，坐回熟悉的办公桌前，安排好工作和休息时间，就可以最小化游戏，继续写代码、处理文件，或完成手头的其他事情。角色在办公室上班，你在屏幕外忙自己的工作。
时间到了，可以让游戏自动回到前台，也可以只用任务栏闪烁或音乐提醒。今天就到这里，还是再做一会儿，由你决定。下班后，Joja 会把工资寄到农场邮箱。
你可以让游戏日期随工作推进，也可以保留农场原来的时间与进度。开场动画支持跳过重复播放，最小化时提供节能选项，工作和休息也能随时提前结束。
适用于 Windows 单人游戏，需要 SMAPI。[/size]

[size=4][color=#00ffff][font=Comic Sans MS][i]Joja Shift works as a Pomodoro-style focus timer, with work sessions and breaks you can set to suit your day. Let your farmer keep you company while you get things done, then take a well-earned break together.[/i][/font][/color][/size]

[size=4]Joja has written again. Your old desk is still waiting.
Accept the invitation and return to the familiar office. Set your work and break times, minimize the game, and get on with your own tasks. Your farmer takes a shift at Joja while you write code, catch up on paperwork, or tackle whatever needs doing.
When time is up, the game can come back to the foreground, flash its taskbar icon, or play a musical reminder. Clock out for a break or stay a little longer for overtime. Once you finish, your wages arrive in the farm mailbox as a letter using the game’s original mail screen.
Let the days pass while you work, or keep your farm’s time and progress as you left them. You can skip repeat showings of the office intro, reduce resource use while the game is minimized, and end work or a break early whenever you need to.
For single-player on Windows. Requires SMAPI.[/size]
